'''Library books''' are found all over [[Azeroth]] in {{g|sod}} and {{g|forever}}. They were a mage-only endeavor in ''Season of Discovery'', as a source of mage runes. In ''Forever'', all classes can find and turn in the books for quest rewards. Turn them in to [[Garion Wendell]] inside the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] of [[Stormwind City]], or [[Owen Thadd]] in the [[Magic Quarter]] of [[Undercity]] for various rewards.

Mages in ''Forever'' who turn in their first book will learn the [[Study]] ability.

==Books==
There are forty books available, some of which have multiple sources and are listed several times in the table. Each book can only be turned in once, regardless of source.
